blurb: Andrew Peller Limited operates nine award-winning wineries in British Columbia and Ontario, producing premium wines and offering wine and culinary experiences. The company hosts over 280,000 visitors annually across its estate properties. It is Canada's largest premium wine producer with a portfolio including Peller Estates, Trius, and Wayne Gretzky brands.
